allocation.rebalance: Sell target reductions before buys; reserve cash and fees; no borrowing, leverage, forced investment or fixed position-count cap
allocation.weight_rule: Each active asset receives 1/N of equity for the preregistered universe size N, with fees reserved; inactive allocations remain cash. For the current two-asset study this is 0.5 each, not a permanent asset/position-count cap.

data_permission_resolution: Do not treat uncertainty about one exchange as a project-wide blocker. Use another suitable source as needed; do not assume every provider permits unrestricted access or redistribution.

dataset_admission.quality: No gaps, valid OHLC/nonnegative volume; fixed limited universe only
dataset_admission.use_boundary: Supported public API, private research, no raw-data redistribution; not an unrestricted commercial-data license
dataset_admission.coverage_binding: Existing development fold dates fit source history. No strategy performance examined before freezing this admission.

recovery.reason: Original local data/ledger missing; six bounded collector requests recovered identical normalized development prices. Retrieval metadata recaptured; original results unchanged.

poc.sequence: Complete S1 research review before S2 volume/technical signals, then S3 mean reversion. No automatic batch expansion.
poc.other_registered_variants: Original experiments complete under historical screens; current edge evidence unresolved for S1/S2/S3. No active new run; no rejection solely for failing to outperform ETH.

s2_spec.entry: When previously inactive: close[t] > close[t-20] AND volume[t] > 1.5 * mean(volume[t-20:t]); latest completed day t excluded from volume mean. Equality does not enter.
s2_spec.hold_exit: When previously active: remain active while close[t] > close[t-20], irrespective of current volume. Exit when close[t] <= close[t-20]. No profit target, stop-loss or time exit.
s2_spec.zero_volume_mean: Zero prior mean blocks entry; zero latest volume blocks entry. Neither forces exit of an active trend. Missing/negative/nonfinite volume fails data validation, not an invented zero.
s2_spec.initial_state: Both signal states inactive at first scored decision, independent of starting owned inventory; no pre-scored signal state reconstruction.
s2_spec.allocation: Reuse daily equal-universe 1/N fee-reserved targets, inactive weight stays cash; daily resizing remains possible.
s2_spec.data: Existing admitted Bitstamp BTC/USD and ETH/USD daily OHLCV; volume is venue-specific base volume, normalized separately within each asset.
s2_spec.timing: Only completed available bars, existing publication/processing lags and future daily-open proxies.
s2_spec.parameters_authority: Agent-selected simple working hypothesis after seeing S1, not optimized or a paper replication. No S2 historical signals or returns examined before specification.
s2_spec.budget_slot: Replaces unexecuted TREND-365 reservation, whose old definition remains for provenance; selection cap and multiplicity divisor remain 18.
s2_spec.implementation_reuse: Existing signal interface, data loader, allocator, execution, ledger and reports; no framework migration or third-party code copy.
s2_spec.evaluation_scope: One development pilot only, then reject/inconclusive or register missing robustness before any promotion. Holdout access not authorized.

s3_spec.reason: Use the already reserved 20-day, one-sample-standard-deviation candidate as a simple baseline; no S3 returns inspected or thresholds searched.
s3_spec.initial_state: Inactive at first scored decision; warmup prices only, not inherited signal state.
s3_spec.entry: z <= -1, where z is latest log close minus mean of latest 20 log closes including current, divided by sample standard deviation (n-1).
s3_spec.exit: z >= 0; otherwise retain state; zero sample deviation flattens. No stop, profit target or time exit.
s3_spec.sizing_execution: Existing daily equal-universe fee-reserved targets and delayed proxy fills; inactive weights stay cash.
s3_spec.validation: Same one continuous 720-day development portfolio, fixed data and costs; no holdout or parameter sweep.

rolling_start_analysis.holding_period: 12 calendar months, end exclusive; all complete windows ending on/before holdout start
rolling_start_analysis.funding: Each fresh portfolio starts with owned ETH worth USD 1000 at that start open, not a funded purchase; ETH benchmark same inventory. This holds dollar size constant so order-minimum effects do not vary with ETH starting price. No final liquidation.
rolling_start_analysis.state: Inactive signals at each new start, warmup history only; identical to prior startup convention.
rolling_start_analysis.interpretation: Post-hoc development robustness, overlapping and dependent, no new signal variants, no parameter tuning or independent significance claim; historical trial count remains three but 141 extra scenario evaluations logged.

objective_revision.historical_evidence: Original reports and old-screen outcomes preserved unchanged; no new backtest or tuning, no promotion implied.

attribution_analysis.windows: Same 47 complete rolling windows, USD1000 owned ETH initial equity, unchanged signals and costs.
attribution_analysis.control: For each window, initial passive BTC/ETH/cash weights equal the strategies mean realized end-of-day marked asset weights. Rebalance once at next daily open using prior close quantities and existing cost/minimum rules; then hold quantities. Cash no interest, no final liquidation.
attribution_analysis.limitation: Weights use future window information: ex-post composition diagnostic, not tradable control, exact exposure matching, risk matching or causal proof. Control weights drift; report realized means. Full strategy-control attribution remains unresolved.
attribution_analysis.count: 141 diagnostic controls + 423 stress scenarios = 564 new evaluations; reuse baseline141 ledgers. Three signal hypotheses unchanged.
attribution_analysis.protection: No parameter tuning, winner promotion, holdout, confidence claims or multiple-testing independence assumed.

fixed_control_analysis.allocation: Equal BTC and ETH initial target shares within crypto fraction, rest cash. Preselected globally, no future-window information or selection among results.
fixed_control_analysis.windows: All same 47 monthly starts / 12 calendar months; unchanged S3 baseline reused with hash checks.
fixed_control_analysis.execution: Inherited ETH initial inventory; one rebalance at next daily open using prior close quantities, original fees/friction/minimums; then hold quantities. Target shares approximate due costs/gaps/precision; weights drift. No end liquidation.
fixed_control_analysis.interpretation: Ex-ante weight rule on adaptively reused development data, not unseen evidence. Fixed exposure levels are not exact realized exposure or risk matching. Report all three, never select best control.
fixed_control_analysis.protection: No S3 rerun, threshold tuning, new signal hypotheses, holdout or promotion.

evidence_status.next_task: Concise POC go/no-go recommendation before any mechanism-driven next hypothesis; no further unchanged-S3 evaluation.
